chapters.title: Integration with Power Apps for data entry
Future plans with AI-assisted demand planning

features.name: Production order management
features.description: Ability to track production from the moment a palet of product is produced to the time it is shipped, with visibility into production timelines.

features.name: Power Apps integration for data entry
features.description: Manufacturing personnel can input data through Power Apps which syncs automatically back to Business Central, eliminating manual data entry on the manufacturing side.

features.name: Production reporting and analytics
features.description: Power App integration enables reporting teams to access data that was previously unavailable, with the ability to trace information across the entire business ecosystem.

features.name: Workflow automation for order processing
features.description: Business Central enables workflow processes for all business functions, reducing the time it takes to process orders from released to finished state.

features.name: AI-assisted demand planning
features.description: Planned capability to incorporate AI to assist with demand planning as the company moves into more automated planning.
features.status_evidence_quote: as we move into more automated planning and bringing in AI assisted demand planning

quotes.text: prior to Dynamics 365 we really did not know how long it would be to produce a palet of product
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates the key business problem that Business Central solved - lack of visibility into production timelines.

quotes.text: now everything is put into production order we can see everything made from the moment it was produced to the time it was shipped
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows how production order management provides end-to-end visibility across the production and fulfillment process.

quotes.text: the people on the manufacturing side they don't need to worry about data entry because everything sinks back to business Central through power apps
quotes.why_it_matters: Illustrates the operational efficiency gained through Power Apps integration eliminating manual data entry in manufacturing.

quotes.text: people are getting data that they didn't even know really existed before and they had no way of capturing
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights how integrated reporting unlocked insights that were previously unavailable to the business.

quotes.text: we've been able to condense the amount of time it takes us to get an order from released to finished
quotes.why_it_matters: Quantifies the process efficiency improvement achieved through workflow automation in Business Central.

quotes.text: business Central in the Power Platform really lets us leverage a small team and create very big outcomes
quotes.why_it_matters: Captures the value proposition of Business Central combined with Power Platform for small business scaling.

disclaimers.text: as we move into more automated planning and bringing in AI assisted demand planning
